title: The Point-Class Rank Functional under Birational Wall Crossing: Irrationality of X × P^m for Every Cubic Threefold
description: This paper proves that the zero or nonzero restriction of the Gamma point row to a formal-monodromy primary packet is invariant under birational maps of smooth projective varieties. The proof uses one smooth projective equivariant completion of a Wlodarczyk cobordism. A common-open orbit cylinder identifies the endpoint point rows, rotation localization kills every intermediate fixed stratum, and complete neutral fixed-graph sums become two residue expansions of one balanced Mellin--Barnes kernel. Rees homogenization and a finite quotient by the intersection of the endpoint kernels reduce the comparison to primary decomposition. For a smooth cubic threefold X, Cai's connection supplies a primitive-sixth block; the paper reconstructs its indicial polynomial and independently proves point-row nonvanishing by a hypergeometric Barnes calculation. Quantum Kunneth then distinguishes X × P^m from projective space for every m, proving stable irrationality. Exact one-wall identities and countermodels explain why a chamberwise telescope cannot replace the global construction.
